sql: SELECT 'bot_runs_30m' k, count(*)::text v, to_char(max(finished_at),'HH24:MI:SS') last FROM bot_runs WHERE started_at > now()-interval '30 min' UNION ALL SELECT 'bot_runs_not_completed_30m', count(*)::text, max(left(error_message,60)) FROM bot_runs WHERE started_at > now()-interval '30 min' AND status<>'completed' UNION ALL SELECT 'ev:'||component, count(*)::text, to_char(max(created_at),'HH24:MI:SS') FROM system_events WHERE created_at > now()-interval '40 min' AND component IN ('mmsell_scan','mmsell_quote_parity') GROUP BY component UNION ALL SELECT 'err:'||level||':'||left(message,70), count(*)::text, to_char(max(created_at),'HH24:MI:SS') FROM system_events WHERE created_at > now()-interval '40 min' AND level IN ('ERROR','CRITICAL') GROUP BY level, left(message,70) UNION ALL SELECT 'paper_new_40m', count(*)::text, to_char(max(created_at),'HH24:MI:SS') FROM paper_trades WHERE created_at > now()-interval '40 min' UNION ALL SELECT 'paper_closed_40m', count(*)::text, to_char(max(closed_at),'HH24:MI:SS') FROM paper_trades WHERE closed_at > now()-interval '40 min' UNION ALL SELECT 'live_orders_40m:'||status, count(*)::text, to_char(max(created_at),'HH24:MI:SS') FROM live_orders WHERE created_at > now()-interval '40 min' GROUP BY status UNION ALL SELECT 'positions_snap_10m', count(*)::text, to_char(max(captured_at),'HH24:MI:SS') FROM positions WHERE captured_at > now()-interval '10 min'
